command.showDetails.title: Model Usage: Show Details
command.refresh.title: Model Usage: Refresh Now
config.pollIntervalSeconds: How often the quota is refreshed automatically (seconds)
config.warnThresholdPercent: Show the status bar in the warning color at or below this remaining percentage
config.dangerThresholdPercent: Show the status bar in the danger color at or below this remaining percentage
config.notifyOnThreshold: Notify when a model's remaining quota drops below a threshold
config.notifyOnReset: Notify when the model quota reset time is reached
config.hiddenModels: Model names to hide (the grouped display name, e.g. "GPT-OSS 120B")
